O Engenheiro(a) de Dados é o profissional que constrói e mantém a infraestrutura responsável por mover, transformar e disponibilizar dados com confiabilidade e performance. Um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados eficaz domina pipelines batch + streaming, otimiza consultas em data-warehouses colunares e garante a rastreabilidade ponta-a-ponta de cada registro. Na prática, atua como elo entre arquitetura e desenvolvimento, permanecendo intrinsecamente ligado(a) ao código que sustenta o fluxo de informações.

Na VMBears, o Engenheiro(a) de Dados é o(a) guardião(ã) da qualidade dos dados : projeta pipelines escaláveis, monitora sua saúde em produção e antecipa gargalos. Para este projeto, a modernização de um motor de cálculo de alto volume no setor de energia, buscamos alguém que una profundidade técnica em processamento distribuído e lakehouse a uma mentalidade de produto baseada em dados.

Você integrará o squad que modernizará o Motor de Cálculo, um engine que processa bilhões de registros, aplica centenas de fórmulas regulatórias e gera resultados contábeis que movem o mercado de energia elétrica. Procuramos alguém que combine habilidade de modelar dados massivos com espírito de colaboração, ajudando o time a migrar de um monolito PL / SQL para uma plataforma distribuída, event-driven e cloud-native, onde cada byte chegue rápido, íntegro e auditável ao novo motor.

Responsabilidades :

  • Implementar soluções com arquitetura de dados distribuída, garantindo latência e throughput que atendam aos requisitos da do negócio;
  • Implantar pipelines de ingestão, transformação e publicação que suportem batch + streaming em larga escala;
  • Seguir padrões de versionamento, catalogação e lineage de dados para rastreabilidade de processamento;
  • Desenvolver processos sempre visando o menor custo e maior performance em Redshift / BigQuery / Athena, propondo ajustes de partição, compressão e caching;
  • Documentar processos e fluxos de trabalho de dados : Manter registros detalhados dos processos de dados para facilitar a manutenção e a melhoria contínua;

Projetar sistemas que possam crescer conforme a demanda por dados aumenta.

Stack desejável :

Terraform / IaC, CI / CD Git, testes de dados automatizados, segurança LGPD (IAM fine-grained, encryption at rest / in transit).

Requisitos imprescindíveis :

Experiência comprovada como Engenheiro de Dados : Ter um histórico sólido na área de engenharia de dados. Pensamento lógico e solução de problemas complexos.

Proficiência em alguma linguagem de programação (Python, Java e outras) e SQL : Ser capaz de usar essas linguagens de programação para manipular e gerenciar dados.

Conhecimento em tecnologias de big data : Familiaridade com ferramentas que permitem o processamento de grandes volumes de dados.

Habilidades de resolução de problemas e pensamento analítico : Capacidade de identificar e resolver problemas complexos de dados. Habilidade de documentação e boas práticas em arquitetura de dados.

description:
Title: Data Architect with AWS & Snowflake experience

Location: 100% Remote

Job Type: Contract

Responsibilities

  • Technical Leadership: Provide technical direction and mentorship to a team of data engineers, ensuring best practices in coding, architecture, and data operations.
  • End-to-End Ownership: Architect, implement, and optimize end-to-end data pipelines that process and transform large-scale datasets efficiently and reliably.
  • Orchestration and Automation: Design scalable workflows using orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow, ensuring high availability and fault tolerance.
  • Data Warehouse and Lake Optimization: Lead the implementation and optimization of Snowflake and data lake technologies like Apache Iceberg for storage, query performance, and scalability.
  • Real-Time and Batch Processing: Build robust systems leveraging Kafka, SQS, or similar messaging technologies for real-time and batch data processing.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Data Science, Product, and Engineering teams to define data requirements and deliver actionable insights.
  • Data Governance and Security: Establish and enforce data governance frameworks, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards and maintaining data integrity.
  • Scalability and Performance: Develop strategies to optimize performance for systems processing terabytes of data daily while ensuring scalability.
  • Team Building: Foster a collaborative team environment, driving skill development, career growth, and continuous learning within the team.
  • Innovation and Continuous Improvement: Stay ahead of industry trends to evaluate and incorporate new tools, technologies, and methodologies into the organization.

Qualifications

Required Skills

  • 8+ years of experience in data engineering with a proven track record of leading data projects or teams.
  • Strong programming skills in Python, with expertise in building and optimizing ETL pipelines.
  • Extensive experience with Snowflake or equivalent data warehouses for designing schemas, optimizing queries, and managing large datasets.
  • Expertise in orchestration tools like Apache Airflow, with experience in building and managing complex workflows.
  • Deep understanding of messaging queues such as Kafka, AWS SQS, or similar technologies for real-time data ingestion and processing.
  • Demonstrated ability to architect and implement scalable data solutions handling terabytes of data.
  • Hands-on experience with Apache Iceberg for managing and optimizing data lakes.
  • Proficiency in containerization and orchestration tools like Docker and Kubernetes for deploying and managing distributed systems.
  • Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, including version control, deployment strategies, and automated testing.
  • Proven experience working in an Agile development environment and managing cross-functional team interactions.
  • Strong background in data modeling, data governance, and ensuring compliance with data security standards.
  • Experience working with cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or GCP.

Preferred Skills

  • Proficiency in stream processing frameworks such as Apache Flink for real-time analytics.
  • Familiarity with programming languages like Scala or Java for additional engineering tasks.
  • Exposure to integrating data pipelines with machine learning workflows.
  • Strong analytical skills to evaluate new technologies and tools for scalability and performance.

Leadership Skills

  • Proven ability to lead and mentor data engineering teams, promoting collaboration and a culture of excellence.
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills to articulate complex technical concepts to stakeholders.
  • Strategic thinking to align data engineering efforts with business goals and objectives.

title: Head Of Finance, Brazil
description:
CONMED Corporation is a progressive, global medical device company, operating in 20 countries. Through thoughtful leadership, innovation and teamwork, we are changing the future of healthcare. Our 3,500 employees worldwide make meaningful contributions, positively impact the business, and advance in their careers as our company and product portfolio grows. We are a leader in Orthopedics, General Surgery, Gynecology, Gastroenterology, Pulmonology, and Anesthesiology and our employees enjoy challenging and diverse job opportunities across these varied specializations. CONMED is headquartered in the United States. Our international presence includes more than 20 locations throughout Canada, Europe, Australia, Latin America, Asia, North America, and the Middle East.

JOB DESCRIPTION

The Finance Director for Brazil is responsible for leading all financial operations, ensuring full compliance with local regulations, strengthening internal controls, optimizing financial performance, developing and supporting strategic business objectives. This role is pivotal in elevating governance, audit readiness, and operational discipline across the Brazilian organization.

This role oversees FP&A, Controllership, Reporting, Accounting, Tax, Treasury, Internal Controls, Compliance, and Financial Governance, while partnering closely with the Country Manager and regional / global Finance leadership to drive sustainable growth, profitability, strong governance and disciplined execution.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Strategic & Financial Leadership

Develop and execute financial strategies aligned with corporate objectives and Brazil's dynamic economic and regulatory environment.

Lead the annual budgeting, forecasting, cash planning, and long‑range planning processes for Brazil.

Serve as a strategic partner to the Country Manager and senior leadership team, providing actionable insights to influence commercial, operational, and organizational decisions.

Monitor market trends, FX volatility, reimbursement dynamics, inflationary pressures, and competitor behavior to inform financial strategy.

Financial Reporting, Compliance & Audit Readiness

Oversee monthly, quarterly, and annual closing processes, ensuring accuracy, transparency, and timely reporting under Brazilian GAAP, IFRS, and corporate accounting standards (including US GAAP, if applicable).

Ensure complete, timely, and compliant statutory reporting, tax filings, SPED obligations (ECD / ECF), and other regulatory submissions.

Lead the Brazil Audit Remediation Plan, ensuring closure of all audit findings (high / medium / low risk) within established timelines.

Strengthen governance, documentation discipline, and financial process transparency to achieve "audit‑ready, always" standards.

Manage external relationships with auditors (Big 4), tax authorities, banks, and regulatory bodies, representing the company with professionalism and financial rigor.

Treasury, Cash Flow & Working Capital Management

Own end‑to‑end cash flow, liquidity planning, and working capital performance (AR, AP, inventory).

Lead banking relationships, credit facility management, financial instruments, FX operations, and covenant monitoring.

Optimize capital structure, credit utilization, hedging strategies, and funding needs in alignment with corporate Treasury.

Drive improvements in collections, DSO, inventory turns, and payment terms to enhance cash generation.

Performance Management & Business Partnering

Deliver comprehensive financial analysis, including P&L performance, balance sheet quality, KPI trends, pricing, and margin enhancement opportunities.

Evaluate commercial strategies, business cases, investments, and distributor economics across franchises, customers, and Brazil geographies.

Collaborate closely with Sales, Marketing, and Operations to improve pricing governance, cost‑to‑serve, product mix optimization, and portfolio profitability.

Internal Controls, Governance & Risk Management

Design, implement, and continuously strengthen internal controls aligned with SOX, corporate governance frameworks, and Brazilian regulatory requirements.

Lead governance of Fixed‑asset tracking and mobility controls, Inventory accuracy, reconciliations, and reporting reliability (including 3PL and distributor consignment).

Build and maintain a comprehensive risk register, governance cadence, and audit calendar.

Systems, ERP & Digital Finance

Lead optimization and governance of ERP and reporting systems, improving data integrity, and reporting accuracy.

Implement analytics and BI tools to enhance management dashboards, forecasting, and business decision‑making.

Team Leadership & Organizational Development

Lead, mentor, and develop a high‑performing Finance organization across Accounting, FP&A, Tax, Treasury, and Controls.

Build strong bench strength and raise capability in financial governance, technical accounting, tax, and analytics.

Lead the team through transformational change, strengthening culture, accountability, and execution discipline.

Foster effective cross‑functional partnerships with Operations, Commercial, Supply Chain, and Service teams.

QUALIFICATIONS

Experience

Minimum 7–10 years in senior finance leadership roles (Finance Director, Country Controller, CFO, or equivalent) within multinational environments.

Proven experience in a similar leadership role or demonstrated potential to successfully assume such responsibilities.

Proven track record in governance turnarounds, internal controls design, and complex compliance environments.

Significant experience managing cash flow, working capital, treasury, and banking relationships.

Demonstrated expertise in Accounting, FP&A, Tax (including indirect taxes), Treasury, and statutory reporting.

Experience in healthcare, pharmaceuticals, or medical devices preferred; understanding of distributors and regulated markets is a plus.

Deep understanding of Brazil's financial, tax, and regulatory landscape.

Strong command of Brazilian GAAP, IFRS, and corporate reporting frameworks including US GAAP.

Advanced analytical thinking with ability to translate data into insights and influence senior decision‑makers.

Strong systems orientation, with hands‑on ERP experience (SAP / Oracle) and BI / reporting tools.

Exceptional communication skills in Portuguese and English, both written and spoken.

Strong leadership presence with the ability to drive accountability, lead change, and elevate organizational capability.

High degree of integrity, assertiveness, discipline, and ownership in managing financial governance.

Education & Credentials

Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field (required).

MBA or advanced degree in Finance, Controllership, or related field (preferred).

Professional certification such as CRC, CPA, CMA, or equivalent strongly preferred.

Additional credentials in internal controls, audit, or compliance are a plus.

Estamos em fase de crescimento e buscamos um(a) Gerente Sênior de Finanças Estratégicas para liderar a área financeira com foco em análise estratégica, planejamento e controle econômico, contribuindo diretamente para as decisões que sustentam a expansão do escritório.

Missão do Cargo

Ser o ponto focal da estratégia financeira da BMZ, garantindo visão analítica e de futuro sobre o negócio — do controle orçamentário ao planejamento tributário, dos resultados financeiros ao equilíbrio econômico entre os setores.

Responsabilidades Principais

  • Elaborar, acompanhar e revisar o orçamento anual e setorial (8 setores do escritório);
  • Analisar o fluxo de caixa e realizar projeções financeiras de curto, médio e longo prazo;
  • Desenvolver e apresentar relatórios financeiros gerenciais (mensais, trimestrais e anuais) aos sócios;
  • Avaliar rentabilidade, margens e indicadores econômicos por setor e por operação;
  • Realizar planejamento e análise tributária em conjunto com o setor contábil;
  • Fazer estudos de valuation, equilíbrio financeiro e precificação dos serviços;
  • Controlar orçamentos e budgets setoriais, validando despesas e investimentos;
  • Apoiar as decisões estratégicas da diretoria, apresentando insights e recomendações financeiras;
  • Estruturar e otimizar processos financeiros, controles internos e políticas de gestão;
  • Participar ativamente das reuniões de gestão estratégica com os sócios.

Requisitos

  • Formação superior em Administração, Economia, Contabilidade ou Finanças;
  • Experiência sólida em planejamento financeiro, controladoria e análise de resultados;
  • Capacidade de conectar finanças com estratégia de negócios;
  • Conhecimento em planejamento tributário e interpretação de indicadores;
  • Excel avançado e domínio de ferramentas de gestão financeira;
  • Perfil analítico, estratégico e orientado a resultados;
  • Disponibilidade para inicio imediato

Diferenciais

  • Experiência anterior em escritório de advocacia ou empresas de serviços;
  • Vivência com indicadores de performance (KPIs) e automação de relatórios;
  • Conhecimento em ERP / Power BI / sistemas de gestão financeira.

Pessoas estão no centro da nossa estratégia e representam nosso maior ativo. Nosso compromisso é atrair, desenvolver e reter os melhores talentos, criando conexões reais e oportunidades consistentes.

Você irá atuar em um cliente multinacional de grande porte, do setor de petróleo e gás.

Buscamos um(a) Data Management Engineer para atuar no suporte, administração e evolução de soluções de Data Management em um ambiente global e multicultural.

Este(a) profissional terá um papel fundamental na estabilidade, performance e melhoria contínua das plataformas de dados, trabalhando com ferramentas líderes de mercado e colaborando com times distribuídos em diferentes fusos horários.

A posição envolve atuação técnica hands-on, automação de processos, monitoramento de ambientes e aplicação de boas práticas de gestão de dados para atender às necessidades de negócio e TI.

Atuar em conjunto com um time global, colaborando com profissionais de diferentes culturas e regiões.

Administrar e prestar suporte a soluções de Data Management, incluindo :

SAP MDG

Monitorar ambientes e aplicações utilizando ferramentas como Datadog, propondo melhorias de performance quando necessário.

Interagir com fornecedores (vendors) para resolução ágil de incidentes e problemas técnicos.

Fornecer suporte técnico especializado e ministrar treinamentos sobre as ferramentas suportadas, quando necessário.

Manter e atualizar documentações de suporte e segurança, garantindo sua precisão e conformidade.

Trabalhar alinhado a práticas Agile, entregando demandas de forma iterativa e planejada.

Aplicar princípios e técnicas de Data Management para entregar soluções eficientes para áreas de negócio e TI.

Automatizar e otimizar processos operacionais por meio de :

  • GitHub Actions para automação de rotinas e pipelines.

Experiência com ferramentas de Data Management e Data Modeling.

Conhecimentos sólidos em :

  • Infraestrutura
  • GitHub

APIs

title: Especialista Em Segurança De Processos - Indústria
description:
O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose / ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC (Forest Stewardship Council) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Sobre a Função

Atuar como responsável por garantir a integridade e a confiabilidade operacional das unidades industriais, prevenindo incidentes relacionados a falhas de processo. Atuar na análise, monitoramento e melhoria contínua dos sistemas de gestão de segurança de processos (PSM), apoiando áreas de operação, manutenção e engenharia na identificação, avaliação e controle de riscos industriais.

GET TO KNOW US

Your wellbeing matters. Join a company that cares.

Wellhub (formerly Gympass*) is a corporate wellness platform that connects employees to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep, all included in one subscription designed to cost less than each individual partner. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in NYC, we have a growing global team in 11 countries. At Wellhub, you have the opportunity to build a career in a high-growth tech company that places wellbeing at the foundation of its culture, and contribute to making every company a wellness company.

*Big news: Gympass is now Wellhub!

We are thrilled to announce our rebranding as Wellhub, marking a significant milestone in our journey. This transformation reflects our evolution from a “pass for gyms” to a comprehensive employee wellbeing solution. With our refreshed identity, we are poised to embark on an exciting new chapter of growth and expansion. We are elevating our offerings, including a completely new app experience and an expanded network of wellbeing partners.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Senior Data Engineer for our CARE - Deep Individual Data team in Portugal! This is a Remote – Portugal position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Portugal.

Join our growing CARE (Coach on Artificial Intelligence for Real Engagement) team at Wellhub and help us build the next generation of AI-powered solutions. This role focuses on organizing and leveraging digital information about users and people to enhance user experience and recommendations.

This project involves collecting user data from various sources in multiple formats (photo, video, text, audio). You will be instrumental in processing, analyzing, and utilizing this data to improve the user experience, user recommendations, business insights, and overall platform quality. Such candidates must be avid learners and be prepared to learn quickly.

We use data and software engineering principles to solve large-scale production challenges. Our infrastructure is completely in the cloud, running many more cutting‑edge projects.

YOUR IMPACT

  • You will develop and maintain data models and structures that enable efficient querying and analysis;
  • You will design, develop, and maintain data pipelines to transform and process large volumes of data from various sources, while adding business context and semantics to the data;
  • You will implement automated data quality checks to guarantee data quality and consistency across the whole data life cycle.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work‑life balance.

Main requirements

WHO YOU ARE

  • You have created robust and scalable data models from business requirements
  • You have worked collaboratively to collect, prepare and analyze complex business data
  • You can engage engineering and product teams to elicit requirements and present solutions to top management
  • Knowledge of data pipeline tools and technologies (e.g., Airflow, EMR, Kafka).
  • You can collaborate with different teams to understand data needs and develop effective data pipelines
  • You are comfortable understanding big data concepts to ingest, process, and make data available for data scientists, business analysts, and product teams
  • You are comfortable maintaining data consistency across the entire data ecosystem
  • You are motivated to contribute to a data‑driven culture and see the impact of your work reflected company‑wide

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in Data Modeling and Data Pipelines is a mandatory requirement.

Benefits & Perks

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

We're a wellness company that is committed to the health and wellbeing of our employees. Our flexible program allows you to customize your benefits, according to your needs!

WELLHUB:

We believe in our mission and encourage our employees and their families to take care of their wellbeing too. Access onsite gyms and fitness studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental health support, and more. You will receive the Gold plan at no cost, and other premium plans will be significantly discounted.

WELLNESS:

Health, dental, and life insurance.

FLEXIBLE WORK:

At Wellhub, flexibility fosters a happier, healthier, and more productive work environment for everyone. As a Flexible First company, we offer two work model options: flexible hybrid and full remote, and make the office a place for collaboration, community, and team building. The model for this role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. We offer all employees a home office stipend and a monthly flexible work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE:

Wellhubbers and their leaders can make the best decisions for their scope. This includes flexibility to adjust their working hours based on their personal schedule, time zone, and business needs.

PAID TIME OFF:

We know how important it is that our employees take time away from work to recharge. Vacations after 6 months and 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + extra day off for your birthday.

PAID PARENTAL LEAVE:

Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life and we want our employees to take the time to be present and enjoy their growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents and extended maternity leave.

CAREER GROWTH:

Outstanding opportunities for personal and career growth. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do and invest deeply in employee development.

CULTURE:

An exciting and supportive atmosphere with ambitious people from around the world! You’ll partner with global colleagues and share in the success of a high‑growth technology company disrupting the health and wellness space. Our value‑based culture of trust, flexibility, and integrity makes this possible every day.

Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub

We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong.

Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. title: Data Engineer
description:
Job Summary

We are seeking a Data Engineer to enhance the resilience and operational stability of our data pipelines, from factory floor to cloud repositories. This critical role will focus on building robust monitoring and support systems, and on accelerating our ability to understand and resolve system and pipeline breakdowns.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and integrate production support technologies and systems to improve data pipeline reliability.
  • Proactively identify vulnerabilities and implement systemic process oriented solutions to enhance pipeline resilience.

  • Assist in meeting data environment governance requirements, specifically related to pipeline data quality and integrity.

Knowledge and Technical Competencies

Soft skills: Organized, proactive, curious, sense of urgency and prioritization, and a strong feeling of ownership.

Technical expertise: Proven experience in systems support, data pipelines, database reliability engineering, and IT production support. Strong background in designing and implementing monitoring, alerting, and logging solutions.

Technical Skills: Proficiency in SQL (queries) and a scripting language (e.g., Python) for data analysis and automation. Hands‑on experience with GCP data technologies (e.g., BigQuery, Dataflow) and monitoring tools (e.g., Grafana, Cloud Monitoring). Familiarity with business intelligence tools (e.g., Looker, Power BI, Tableau) for dashboarding.

Desired qualifications: Knowledge of process industry KPIs. Familiarity with data governance platforms (e.g., Collibra) and data transformation tools (e.g., Dataform). Multilingual English / Spanish / Portuguese would be a plus. Experience with Production Support would be a plus.

Background: Degree in Engineering or Computer Science.

Duration: 18 weeks (Independant Contractor) without benefits

Work Model: Remote

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled ITS Business Analyst (Analytics) to support a critical analytics and data-platform transformation initiative. The ideal candidate will bring 5–7 years of business analysis experience , strong SQL expertise , and hands‑on exposure to cloud-based analytics environments .

This role will play a key part in application rationalization and data migration efforts , including the transition from SAP S/4HANA to Snowflake . You will assess current‑state analytics solutions, identify data gaps, and support the rebuilding and repointing of dashboards and reports to the future‑state data platform.

Agile/Scrum experience is preferred, though Waterfall experience is acceptable .

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with business stakeholders to gather, document, and analyze requirements for analytics and reporting solutions.
  • Review existing analytics applications and support application rationalization initiatives.
  • Assess current-state SAP S/4HANA/HANA data sources and identify future-state data gaps as systems migrate to Snowflake .
  • Support the repointing and rebuilding of dashboards and reports to new cloud data sources.
  • Translate business needs into clear data, reporting, and KPI requirements .
  • Work closely with data engineers, architects, and analytics teams to ensure accurate and timely delivery.
  • Develop and maintain dashboards and visualizations using Power BI, Tableau, or Looker .
  • Perform day‑to‑day SQL analysis to validate data, investigate issues, and support insights.
  • Create user stories, functional specifications, and process flows for analytics initiatives.
  • Facilitate workshops and working sessions to understand business processes and identify optimization opportunities.
  • Monitor KPIs and performance metrics to measure the success of analytics solutions.
  • Act as a liaison between business and technical teams to ensure alignment and clarity.
  • Support data governance practices to ensure data quality, consistency, and reliability.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or a related field.
  • 5–7 years of experience as a Business Analyst, preferably in analytics or data‑driven environments.
  • Strong SQL proficiency with hands‑on experience querying and validating data.
  • Experience working with cloud platforms and data warehouses (Azure and/or Snowflake preferred).
  • Experience supporting analytics projects with an understanding of data modeling concepts (hands‑on modeling not required).
  • Excellent communication, documentation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving abilities.
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies (Waterfall experience acceptable).

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with data modeling and ETL concepts .
  • Exposure to SAP S/4HANA or HANA‑based reporting environments .
  • Knowledge of statistical analysis or machine learning concepts.
  • Business Analysis certifications such as CBAP, PMI‑PBA , or similar.

You will join a dynamic, cross‑functional team of User Researchers, Product Designers, Product Managers, and Engineers, collaborating to uncover user needs and drive innovation. Our team operates in agile squads, with a strong emphasis on autonomy, continuous learning, and democratising research insights across the organisation.

What sets this role apart

  • Strategic Ownership: You will own the research agenda, set direction, and ensure research is a key driver of business and product strategy.
  • Cross-Product Impact: You will lead research initiatives that span multiple products and domains, synthesising insights to inform company‑wide strategy.
  • Mentorship & Leadership: You will be a role model and coach for other researchers, raising the bar for research quality and impact.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own and drive research strategy across multiple products and domains, directly influencing product vision, roadmaps, and broader business decisions.
  • Lead cross‑product research initiatives: Identify and drive research programmes that span multiple products or business areas, ensuring insights are synthesised and leveraged across teams to inform company‑wide strategy.

  • Build strong relationships with executives, product managers, and cross‑functional leaders: Drive alignment and buy‑in for research‑driven decisions.
  • Craft compelling stories from research findings: Influence decision‑making at the leadership level through clear, impactful communication.
  • Collaborate on operational and strategic initiatives: Work with the research team and Senior UX Manager to develop and improve Research Ops processes, manage the research repository (Dovetail), implement analytics tooling (e.g., screen recording, heatmaps), and run NPS measurement programmes for key journeys.
  • Support brand and marketing research: Partner with the Brand team on targeted research projects that inform positioning, messaging, and user experience for major strategic initiatives.
  • Represent Hostelworld externally: Advocate for a user‑centric culture and share research insights at conferences or in publications, as appropriate.
  • Stay ahead of industry trends: Synthesise market and competitor insights to inform strategy and maintain Hostelworld’s leadership in UX research.

Main requirements

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Experience & Qualifications:

  • A portfolio showcasing strategic UX leadership, innovative research, and measurable business impact.
  • 5+ years of experience in UX research, with a strong record of impact across digital products and platforms.

OUR BEHAVIOURS

  • Grow others - We fundamentally believe that investing in growing others benefits everyone, whether it's helping them develop hard or soft skills. We want learning and growing to be part of our DNA to help makes us a better team, together.
  • Master it - We are obsessed with our area of expertise and enjoy developing our skills. We rarely take things at face value; we investigate, interrogate, and always look for ‘the why,’ and wherever possible, we use data to find the best solution.

  • Adapt - We work fluidly, adapting to new information and the evolving environment while staying committed to our goals. Innovation and experimentation fuel our projects and we’re never afraid to pivot.
  • Deliver - Our focus is always on the end result; we value outcomes over activity. We collaborate to deliver work at speed without dropping any of our other behaviours.

About Olly Olly

Ready to roll up your sleeves and help transform local marketing forever? At Olly Olly, we’re blending technology and real‑world expertise to empower businesses across the U.S. like never before.

We believe small businesses are the backbone of our economy. That’s why we’re on a mission to provide them with tools, strategies, and insights that help them rank higher, generate high‑quality leads, get calls and reviews, and, above all, grow sustainably, without the hassle.

Our Vision

We aim to be the ultimate all‑in‑one platform for small business growth, allowing owners to manage every part of their business efficiently and effortlessly.

Our journey began as an agency, and we’ve already helped thousands of clients succeed. Now, we’re embracing an exciting new chapter: becoming a SaaS‑first company. By combining hard‑earned human expertise with AI and automation, we’re creating affordable solutions that give business owners peace of mind while driving measurable success.

Why We Need You

We're seeking a battle‑tested WordPress Developer & Landing Page Team Lead who has personally managed the technical execution of high‑stakes marketing campaigns with millions of dollars in ad spend.

This isn't a role for someone who's built a few landing pages—we need someone who has been the person responsible for ensuring every pixel fires correctly, every form submits properly, and every dollar of ad spend has a clear path to conversion tracking.

You’ll lead a team of two WordPress developers, managing multiple concurrent projects while maintaining the exacting standards required when significant marketing budgets are on the line. You’ll be the technical bridge between our marketing campaigns (primarily Meta, but across various channels) and our HubSpot CRM, ensuring flawless data flow and attribution tracking.

Core Responsibilities

Landing Page Development & Campaign Execution

  • Design, build, and deploy high‑converting landing pages optimized for paid traffic from Meta, Google, and other advertising platforms
  • Own the complete technical implementation of marketing campaigns from concept through launch
  • Ensure pixel‑perfect tracking setup across all campaigns, including Meta Pixel, Google Analytics, conversion tracking, and retargeting audiences
  • Implement and troubleshoot complex tracking scenarios including server‑side tracking, UTM parameters, and multi‑touch attribution
  • Optimize landing page performance for speed, mobile responsiveness, and conversion rates
  • Conduct A/B testing and implement rapid iterations based on campaign performance data

HubSpot Integration & Data Management

  • Build and maintain seamless integrations between landing pages and HubSpot CRM
  • Ensure accurate lead capture, form submissions, and data synchronization
  • Implement and validate proper lead source attribution and campaign tracking in HubSpot
  • Create custom workflows and automations to support campaign objectives
  • Troubleshoot data discrepancies and ensure marketing attribution accuracy

Technical Leadership & Team Management

  • Provide direction and day‑to‑day guidance to two WordPress developers while remaining hands‑on in execution
  • Manage workload distribution across multiple concurrent projects and campaigns
  • Establish and enforce development standards, quality assurance protocols, and best practices
  • Conduct code reviews and provide constructive technical feedback
  • Create project timelines and ensure on‑time delivery of campaign assets
  • Serve as the escalation point for complex technical challenges

Quality Assurance & Risk Management

  • Implement rigorous QA processes before any campaign launch
  • Maintain detailed documentation of tracking implementations and technical specifications
  • Proactively identify and resolve potential issues before they impact campaign performance
  • Ensure compliance with privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA) in all tracking implementations

Required Qualifications

5+ years of professional WordPress development experience

  • Direct experience managing technical execution of marketing campaigns with $1M+ in total ad spend
  • Must have been the PRIMARY person responsible for landing page build and campaign launch (not just a contributor on a larger team)
  • Portfolio demonstrating high‑converting landing pages you've personally built and deployed

Technical Expertise

  • Proven experience implementing Git‑based version control (GitLab, GitHub, or Bitbucket) and configuring Continuous Integration / Continuous Delivery (CI / CD) pipelines for WordPress. Must be proficient in automating deployment across environments (Dev, Staging, Prod) and integrating unit and end‑to‑end tests into the workflow.
  • Expert‑level WordPress development skills including ACF, Gutenberg, custom theme development, plugin customization, and advanced page builders (Elementor, Divi, or similar)
  • Deep understanding of Meta Business Suite, Meta Pixel implementation, and Conversions API
  • Proven experience with HubSpot CRM integration, forms, and tracking implementation
  • Experience with VueJS (plus)
  • Experience with conversion tracking pixels across multiple platforms (Meta, Google, LinkedIn, etc.)
  • Knowledge of Google Tag Manager and server‑side tracking implementations
  • Understanding of marketing analytics, attribution models, and conversion optimization principles

Management & Communication

  • Demonstrated experience leading and mentoring developers
  • Exceptional project management skills with the ability to juggle multiple high‑priority projects
  • Clear communication style with both technical and non‑technical stakeholders
  • Comfortable with accountability when significant marketing budgets are at stake
  • Ability to explain complex technical concepts to marketing team members

Performance Standards

  • Meticulous attention to detail—one misconfigured pixel can cost thousands in wasted ad spend
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet tight campaign launch deadlines
  • Proactive problem‑solver who anticipates issues before they become problems
  • Commitment to continuous learning as platforms and tracking methods evolve

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with marketing automation platforms beyond HubSpot (Marketo, Pardot, ActiveCampaign)
  • Familiarity with conversion rate optimization (CRO) methodologies and tools
  • Knowledge of SQL for custom reporting and data analysis
  • Experience with A/B testing platforms (VWO, Optimizely, Google Optimize)
  • Understanding of SEO best practices for landing pages
  • Certifications in Meta Blueprint, Google Analytics, or HubSpot
  • Experience in agency or fast‑paced startup environments

What Success Looks Like

First 30 Days

  • Audit current landing page infrastructure and tracking implementations
  • Meet with marketing team to understand campaign objectives and conversion goals
  • Review existing team workflows and identify optimization opportunities
  • Successfully launch first campaign under your management with zero tracking issues

First 90 Days

  • Establish standardized QA protocols and documentation for all campaign launches
  • Implement improvements to team efficiency and project management processes
  • Build trust with marketing team through flawless technical execution
  • Identify and resolve any lingering tracking or integration issues

First Year

  • Lead team through successful execution of major product launch campaigns
  • Demonstrably improve landing page conversion rates through testing and optimization
  • Establish Olly Olly's landing page function as a competitive advantage
  • Develop your team members' skills and create succession planning

Why This Role Matters

When we invest in marketing campaigns, every dollar needs to count. You’ll be the person ensuring that our tracking is accurate, our data is clean, and our ability to optimize is never compromised by technical issues. Your work directly impacts our ability to scale profitably and serve more small business owners.

Job Title : Finance Business Partner (Brazil)

Job Requirements

Bachelor's degree or above in Finance, Accounting, or a related field

3–5 years of relevant financial experience; candidates with experience in large trading companies, supply chain organizations, financial BP roles, financial analysis, or Brazilian tax-related work are preferred

Proficient in Chinese and Portuguese, both can be used as working languages

Key Responsibilities :

1. Budget Management

Support annual budget planning in line with the Group's budgeting guidelines; communicate budget policies and assist business units in budget preparation, target setting, and execution planning.

2. Business & Financial Analysis

Develop a deep understanding of business operations; analyze financial and operational performance and provide actionable insights and recommendations to support management decision-making.

3. Business Partnership & Collaboration

Work closely with business teams to optimize processes and improve operational efficiency; respond promptly to business project needs and provide financial support.

4. Process & Data Management

Collaborate across departments to streamline workflows, clarify business data logic, and drive process optimization; align business and functional teams on data governance and reporting standards.

5. Finance & Tax Support

Manage financial and tax risks through contract review and payment approval processes; provide professional finance and tax advice and coordinate the resolution of tax-related matters with relevant stakeholders.

Promote and implement company financial policies and procedures; organize financial training sessions and provide ongoing financial guidance and professional support to business teams.

title: Sr. Full Stack Engineer
description:
Who We Are:

PureSpectrum is a rapidly growing market research and insights platform that simplifies technology, allowing researchers to gather and activate consumer data without disruption. As the go-to solution for high-quality multi-sourcing and fully automated research, PureSpectrum is helping to shape the future of insights.

Our Marketplace facilitates over 65 million online interviews annually, and our proprietary respondent‑level scoring system, PureScore, continues to set the industry standard for data quality and reliability.

Recognized globally for both innovation and culture, PureSpectrum has been named one of Newsweek’s Global Most Loved Workplaces (2023–2025), included in Inc.’s Best Workplaces (), certified as a Great Place to Work (2022–2025), and featured on Built In’s Best Places to Work list (2023–2025). PS is rapidly becoming the leading solution for quality multi-sourcing and end‑to‑end automated research solution.

The Opportunity:

PureSpectrum is seeking a highly skilled Sr. Engineer to join our high‑impact Product & Engineering team. This is a full‑stack role with a primary emphasis on backend engineering. You will be responsible for architecting, developing, and maintaining the core services, scalable RESTful APIs, and cloud infrastructure that power our mobile application. In addition to infrastructure and API design, you will optimize database interactions to ensure high performance. This is a fast‑paced role within our global organization, reporting directly to the Engineering Manager.

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Your Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop scalable, robust RESTful API endpoints using .NET Core to support high‑volume data consumption.
  • Design and optimize database structures using MySQL and write optimized queries for better performance and data integrity.
  • Implement and maintain server‑side logic, integrating with third‑party services using C# and object‑oriented design principles.
  • Deploy and maintain scalable cloud solutions on AWS, specifically utilizing EC2/Beanstalk, RDS, SQS, SES, SNS, S3, and Lambda.
  • Test drive development and write comprehensive Unit/Integration tests to ensure code quality and stability.
  • Follow best practices in version control (Git), CI/CD, and cloud deployments to ensure efficient release cycles.
  • Implement new features in our mobile app using Flutter.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science or a similar discipline from any recognized University.
  • 3-5 years of hands‑on experience building back‑end applications using .NET Core and ORMs like Entity Framework.
  • Strong proficiency in C# and deep understanding of MVC design patterns.
  • AWS Cloud Expertise: Proven experience designing, deploying, and maintaining scalable and reliable cloud solutions leveraging core AWS services, including EC2/Beanstalk, RDS, SQS, SES, SNS, S3, and Lambda.
  • Strong understanding of relational databases with a preference for MySQL, including schema design and query optimization.
  • Knowledge of JSON, HTML, YAML, REST standards, and Git version control.
  • Knowledge of build pipelines (e.g., AWS CodePipeline, Bitbucket, GitLab).
  • Knowledge of Linux and command line interface operations.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Basic knowledge of Flutter and/or native mobile development (iOS/Android), including the MVVM design pattern

Nice to Have

  • Experience with mobile development technologies, specifically Flutter/Dart.
  • Experience with Firebase.
  • Knowledge of Shell script, JavaScript, and Native mobile development for Android/iOS.
  • Experience in Agile/Scrum teams.
  • Comfort with fast‑moving teams and working across time zones with distributed teams.

PureSpectrum Perks:

Join PureSpectrum and become part of our innovative culture (PSX), where we prioritize your professional growth and foster a strong sense of team connection. You'll be part of a rewarding, high‑standard environment where team members genuinely enjoy regular celebrations and events—a truly exceptional experience at every level.

PureSpectrum is an equal opportunity employer. Applicants will not be discriminated against because of race, color, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, religion, national origin, citizenship status, disability, ancestry, marital status, veteran status, medical condition, or any protected category prohibited under the law.

title: DevOps Pleno/Sênior
description:
Quem somos nós?

Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.

Nosso propósito é impactar positivamente pessoas e negócios , exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livreb> para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor .

Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!

Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:

  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. A jornada é flexível conforme agendas e entregas.
  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.

O que buscamos?

Estamos em busca de um/uma DevOps para fazer parte de nosso movimento. Quem ocupar esta posição será responsável por gerenciar o ciclo de vida completo de aplicações, desde o desenvolvimento até a entrega em produção, garantindo eficiência e agilidade por meio da automação e de metodologias ágeis.

Como será seu dia-a-dia?

Seu dia-a-dia será dinâmico e desafiador, com atividades que envolvem desde o desenvolvimento de pipelines de integração e entrega contínuas, até a manutenção de infraestrutura cloud.

Você terá a oportunidade de atuar em empresas de grande porte, auxiliando a equipe a alcançar resultados mais rápidos e eficientes através da adoção de metodologias ágeis e da automação de processos. Incluindo atividades como:

  • Gerenciar e manter ambientes de infraestrutura cloud.
  • Implementar e gerenciar soluções de infraestrutura como código (IaC), utilizando ferramentas como Terraform, CloudFormation ou Azure Resource Manager.
  • Desenvolver e otimizar pipelines de CI/CD, automatizando processos de integração e entrega contínuas.
  • Criar e manter scripts de automação para tarefas rotineiras e de configuração.
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria contínua no processo de entrega de software e implementação de otimizações.
  • Resolver incidentes e problemas de produção de maneira rápida e eficaz, garantindo a estabilidade dos sistemas.
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares e comunicar-se efetivamente com outras áreas da empresa.

Resultados esperados incluem

a otimização do tempo de desenvolvimento, a redução do tempo de lançamento de nova versões em produção e a melhoria contínua do processo de entrega de software. Exemplos de entregáveis incluem a configuração e manutenção de ambientes de infraestrutura cloud, o desenvolvimento de scripts de automação de tarefas e pipelines de CI/CD, além da resolução de incidentes e problemas de produção.

Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa dominar:

  • Experiência com plataformas de orquestração de containers, como Kubernetes, Docker Swarm ou Openshift
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de gestão de configuração, como Ansible, Puppet e Chef
  • Experiência em linguagens de programação, como Python, Ruby ou Go, para automatizar tarefas e desenvolver pipelines de CI/CD
  • Conhecimento em práticas DevOps e metodologias ágeis
  • Familiaridade com infraestruturas cloud, como AWS, Azure ou GCP
  • Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento (Observabilidade) e gerenciamento de LOGs, como Datadog, NewRelic, Dynatrace, Prometheus, Grafana e Elasticsearch
  • Experiência com a prática de infraestrutura como código, utilizando ferramentas como Terraform, CloudFormation e/ou Azure Resource Manager para provisionar e gerenciar infraestrutura cloud.

O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?

  • Auxílio Alimentação (VA/VR) no cartão Caju;
  • Auxílio Home-Office no cartão Caju;
  • Programa de Pontos Flexíveis em seu Caju - um valor fléxivel para você usar como você quiser;
  • Plano de Saúde Nacional Porto Seguro (Plano Prata com apartamento e sem coparticipação) com 50% da mensalidade custeada pela Builders;
  • Assistência Odontológica pela Porto Seguro (Plano Bronze) com 100% da mensalidade paga pela Builders;
  • Auxílio Creche para crianças de até 72 meses;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Mental - acesso ao aplicativo Vida+;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Física - acesso ao aplicativo Gympass;
  • Seguro de vida.
